title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review - daily scratchpad
content:
2026-03-02 - morning sprint notes

Top priorities for today:
- Finish vendor evidence request email for SecureVault (encryption-at-rest provider) — include certs + KMS integration docs.
- Verify current KMS key rotation logs for prod (need log export for 2025-12 to 2026-02).
- Triage JIRA-SEC-412 (missing access review artifacts for external contractors) — assign owners.
- Quick sync with Asha at 11:00 on policy updates (data retention + incident response edits).

Quick TODOs (timeboxed):
[ ] Draft SecureVault evidence email (send by EOD). Notes: ask for HSM attestation doc, algorithm details (AES-256?), key lifecycle steps, SOC2-friendly statement of shared responsibility.
[ ] Export KMS rotation logs (from cloud-kms-prod) for 2025-12-01 -> 2026-02-28. Need CSV for evidence bundle. Who has access: infra-oncall, sops-admin.
[ ] Pull last access review spreadsheet (users with service account keys) and update outstanding review column. Link: CONFLUENCE-SEC Access Reviews
[ ] Follow up with Eng infra on PR #289 for automated evidence upload to confluence (is PR blocking our evidence exports?).
[ ] Update policy-drafts: incident-response runbook small edits from legal — collect comments and mark accept.

Notes / fragments:
- SecureVault vendor: initial security questionnaire answered in Jan; missing: key rotation proof + KMS integration diagram. Ask for timeline for rotating keys older than 1 year.
- Evidence mapping:
  * CC6.1 (logical access) -> access_review_sheet.csv + JIRA-SEC-412 notes
  * CC7.1 (encryption) -> SecureVault certs + KMS rotation logs + config screenshot (kms-prod/bindings)
  * CC3.2 (change mgmt) -> release engineering PRs and changelog (link to infra PRs)
- For evidence bundle: zip naming convention: redwood-soc2-evidence-YYYYMMDD-<control>.zip

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we accept vendor attestations older than 12 months? (legal prefers <=12 months, but some vendors only do annual). Need decision from legal on exceptions.
- Who will be the sign-off for external contractor access reviews? Suggest: Noah (security) + Eng manager. Add to JIRA-SEC-412.

Meeting notes (11:00 with Asha):
- Agreed to shorten incident-response retention to 2 yrs for non-PHI logs.
- Asha will consolidate legal comments by Fri 2026-03-06.
- Action: update runbook version and add changelog entry.

Links to reference artifacts (quick):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/com/display/SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Index
- Access review sheet: https://sheets.redwood.com/spreadsheets/d/access-review-2026
- JIRA-SEC-412: https://jira.redwood/browse/SEC-412
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/289

Personal notes (to self):
- Keep evidence filenames consistently formatted (lowercase, dashes).
- When emailing vendors, cc: security-ops@redwood and legal@redwood.
- If vendor provides only a pen-test summary (no full report), request redacted exec summary + scope.

End of notes. Will update after SecureVault reply or when KMS logs exported.

Recent edits: added checklist items for PR #289 and clarified evidence naming conventions.
